{{Quote|It is approximately 1:30 in the morning, Coordinated Galactic Time, right?"''<br />"''1:31:27, to be exact, sir.|Corran Horn and Emtrey|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
The '''Coordinated Galactic Time''' was a basis of measuring [[Time/Legends|time]]. It was based on the current time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
